description: Church Street Pedestrianization Pilot - Public Life Study is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. The Church Street Pedestrianization Pilot Evaluation datasets provide information collected to assess the impacts of the pedestrianization of Church Street between Wellesley Street East and Alexander Street during the summer of 2026. This dataset consists of Public Life Study (PLS) reports prepared by an external consultant, including baseline and during-pilot findings. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. It offers 3 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2026-07-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
